text:
sara (support): Heads up — customer Nimbus reported a sudden drop in vectors/sec starting ~02:15 UTC. Tokens/sec looks normal (no request failures), but vectors throughput fails SLA. They say latency spiked even though API returns 200.

devon: @sara can you paste a sample request and approximate payload sizes? Any dimension mismatch errors in the logs? :eyes:

sara (support): Quick curl they ran: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"nimbus-embed","input":["short text..."...]}'
```
Most requests are small strings (~30-120 chars).

ops-bot: ALERT: pool-p-18 queue_depth=94% gpu_util=78% io_wait=5% (2026-03-16 02:18:12 UTC)

alan (eng-runtime): I noticed we rolled the new batching window policy at 01:49 and then a partial rollback at 01:52. Could be batch sizing oscillation. Can someone dump recent batch size histogram and per-batch latency?

kim (ml-eng): Found some dim mismatch traces in the router logs: 
```
ERROR DimMismatch: expected_embedding_dim=2048 got=1536 request_id=77a3b2c
```
A subset of clients are sending smaller vectors — maybe SDK change? Those requests cause different kernel selection and longer per-token time.

sara (support): Nimbus says they upgraded their client to sdk-js v1.4.2 on Mar 15. Repro steps from customer: 1) flood 10k short inputs, 2) vectors/sec steady then collapses after ~6k requests. They can share packet captures.

devon: Running a local repro w/ 10k short inputs now. Observing vectors/sec ~4200/s initially, then drops to ~900/s correlating with queue_depth spike. Trying toggling batch window: `--batch-window=10ms` vs `50ms` to see effect.

alan (eng-runtime): Hypothesis: tokenization variance from SDK update produces variable sequence lengths -> runtime flips between optimized and fallback kernels; kernel churn + KV cache thrash increases latency and reduces throughput. Dumped kernel selection log for a period: 
```
DEBUG kernel_swap_count=12 last_swap_reason=seq_len_variance
```

ops-bot: DEBUG: kernel_swap_count=12 last_swap_reason=seq_len_variance (correlated with queue spikes)

kim (ml-eng): Short-term mitigation: gateway reject for mismatched dims and a softblock for sdk versions >=1.4.2 while we patch. Recommend asking Nimbus to pin to sdk-js v1.4.0. Also adding dimension validation at ingress so we drop bad payloads quickly instead of routing them through the slow path.

sara (support): Escalating to account team + SRE. Notifying Nimbus of workaround (pin to v1.4.0) and ETA for permanent fix. @devon can you open a dedicated incident and attach repro artifacts and logs? :thumbsup:

devon: Creating ticket INC-8621, attaching: minimal repro script, batch histograms, kernel selection trace, and sample DimMismatch logs. Will follow up with a small mitigation PR to gate client version at the gateway.

alan (eng-runtime): Next steps for eng-runtime: reproduce with their exact sdk bundle, add a short-circuit for obvious dim mismatch, and evaluate whether a slightly larger default batch window stabilizes kernel selection.

kim (ml-eng): I'll prepare a microbenchmark to measure fallback kernel perf vs optimized kernel across seq_len distributions and share numbers tomorrow.

sara (support): Thanks all — customer updated in-thread that pinning SDK stops the regression for them. Keeping the channel updated on the patch rollout.
